resources.string: No games found. Add your rom folder with the menu (📋 → Add folder).
Covers are picked up automatically: put game.png / game.jpg next to the rom, or in a covers/ subfolder.
One JSON object per line: name, package, activity (optional), viewAction. These entries are tried top-down when you tap a game. Edit if your emulator build uses another package name.
These values are saved per game and applied whenever the launcher can control the core (bundled core, phase 2). With an installed emulator they are a reference preset.
